question: Who defected against Siraj-ud-Daulah in the battle of Plassey?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mir Jafar**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Battle of Plassey was fought between the East India Company headed by Robert Clive and the Nawab of Bengal (Siraj-Ud-Daulah) and his French Troop.
 
• It took place on June 23, 1757.
 
• Mir Jafar (Commander-in-Chief of Nawab’s army) cheated Siraj-Ud-Daulah during the battle.
 
• Mir Jafar was Bribed by the East India Company (EIC).
 
• Later Mir Jafar was to be made the Nawab by EIC for conspiring against Siraj-Ud-Daulah.
 
• British East India Company made Mir Jafar the first dependent Nawab of Bengal under them.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Major causes of the Battle of Plassey:​

 
 
• The rampant misuse of the trade privileges given to the British by the Nawab of Bengal.
 
• Non-payment of tax and duty by the workers of the British East India Company.
 
• Fortification of Calcutta by the British without Nawab’s permission.
 
• Misleading Nawab on various fronts by British.
 
• An asylum was provided to Nawab’s enemy Krishna Das
